title: Footsteps on the Ceiling
premise: A tenant living on the top floor of an old building realizes the footsteps pacing above his bed are walking upside down on his ceiling.
subgenre: paranormal encounter in an ordinary home

title: The Mysterious Disappearance of Jim Thompson
premise: An American businessman who revitalised the Thai silk industry vanished during a walk in Malaysia's Cameron Highlands in 1967.

title: The Legend of the Manananggal
premise: A mythical creature from Philippine folklore separates its upper torso to hunt at night.

title: Platform Four
premise: A security guard working at a sealed underground terminal is forbidden from looking inside the phantom train that stops every morning at 3:15 AM.
subgenre: 'rules' horror (a list of strange rules at a job or place)

title: The Beast of Gévaudan
premise: A cryptid terrorized south-central France between 1764 and 1767, resulting in dozens of deaths and an unsolved mystery.

title: The German Legend of the Nachzehrer
premise: A dead revenant in German folklore drains the life-force of the living by consuming its own funeral shroud.
